figures.finding: No person may employ a child under fourteen; a child of fourteen or more may be employed in light work (excerpts; the full sections couldn't be read).

value.note: from search excerpts of the 2017 Regulations and of a judgment quoting ELRA s. 5

figures.applies: Employment and Labour Relations Act 2004 s. 5; Employment and Labour Relations (General) Regulations 2017 (GN 47).

sources.said: No person shall employ a child under the age of fourteen years ... person shall employ or cause to be employed a child under the age of fourteen ... of fourteen of age and above may be employed to perform light work which is not
